clue.text: Uninteresting sets-least used

indicators.note: the letters of the hyphenated pair are used up again in a new order, signalling a rearrangement

explanation.surface: A dull lot of sets, the least often used.
explanation.walkthrough: 'used' tells you to rearrange SETSLEAST.
explanation.definitionFit: Something without flavour or interest is called insipid or bland, the same sense.

clue.text: Island race in trouble with a conqueror

indicators.note: the race and island pieces sit in the word for trouble, so 'in' marks a container

parts.note: to ail is to trouble or afflict
TT is the Tourist Trophy motorcycle race on the Isle of Man

explanation.surface: An island race runs into trouble with a would-be conqueror.
explanation.walkthrough: The pieces go into AIL in answer order, TT then I, giving A-TTI-L, then A is added.
explanation.definitionFit: The fifth-century leader of the Huns overran much of Europe, the archetypal invader.

clue.text: A man turning green 'has an alternative

indicators.note: turning round tells you to read the colour word backwards

parts.note: vert is green in heraldry
or is the word that introduces an alternative

explanation.surface: A man going green is offered another choice.
explanation.walkthrough: Vert is the heraldic term for green, a convention worth knowing. The stray apostrophe before 'has' is a newspaper misprint.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a common male first name, so any example of a man fits.

clue.text: An amateur punter?

definitions.meaning: a non-professional, someone without expert training

explanation.definitionFit: A non-expert is a lay person; read whimsically, a person who lays a bet.

clue.text: Arab or Japanese coppers holding a vehicle up

indicators.note: the coin word holds the other pieces inside it, a container signal

parts.note: the sen is a small Japanese coin, one hundredth of a yen

indicators.note: in a down clue 'up' means the vehicle is read from bottom to top

parts.note: a car is a vehicle

explanation.surface: An Arab, or Japanese police holding a car up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Coppers' looks like police but means small coins; 'up' turns only the vehicle, giving RAC.
explanation.definitionFit: Medieval Europeans used the name for Arabs and Muslims generally, especially in the Crusades.

clue.text: Pompous old monarch having need of no aides maybe

parts.note: GR stands for Georgius Rex, a King George of the past

indicators.note: maybe suggests the letters could be arranged another way

explanation.surface: A stuffy old king who needs no helpers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'maybe' makes ANDIOSE from the letters of 'no aides'; 'having need of' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words describe someone showy and self-important, inflated in manner.

clue.text: Can beginner operate this kitchen equipment?

parts.note: a can is a tin
an opener is the one who begins something

explanation.surface: Asking whether a novice can work this kitchen gadget.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Can' looks like a verb meaning 'is able to', but it is the noun for a container.
explanation.definitionFit: A hand tool for cutting the lids off cans is a standard kitchen gadget.

clue.text: Being sorry for egghead imprisoned, phone about it

indicators.note: the phone word goes around the other pieces, so 'about' marks a container

parts.note: to ring is to phone
the head of the word egg is its first letter E
pent, as in pent up, means shut in or confined

explanation.surface: Feeling remorse for locking up an intellectual, a caller phones about it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'egghead' looks like an intellectual but gives the first letter of egg.
explanation.definitionFit: To feel regret and contrition for a wrong is to show remorse.

clue.text: Giving the little page an increase in pay, express appreciation

parts.note: p is the short form of page
a raise is a pay rise

explanation.surface: Thanking the young page by giving him a pay rise.
explanation.definitionFit: To commend or applaud someone is to show approval and gratitude.

clue.text: Very hard way to keep a balance

parts.note: steely means as hard as steel
RD is the abbreviation for road, a way

explanation.surface: A tough road to holding steady.
explanation.walkthrough: A steelyard is an old weighing device with a sliding counterweight, so 'balance' is the noun.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a kind of weighing scale with a sliding weight on an unequal arm.

clue.text: Call for a replay

parts.note: reads like a demand for a match to be played again, but means an audience's shout for a performer to play more

explanation.definitionFit: The audience's shout for an extra performance at the end of a concert.

clue.text: Rebuilt wall on a church grant

indicators.note: a rebuilt wall has its parts put together again in a different way, a rearrangement

parts.note: CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: A grant to rebuild the church wall.
explanation.walkthrough: WALLONA rearranges to ALLOWAN, then CE.
explanation.definitionFit: A sum of money given regularly or for a purpose is a grant.

clue.text: Having one about in a bird sanctuary is most delightful

indicators.note: the other pieces are placed in the bird's home, a container signal

parts.note: a nest is a bird's safe home
I is the Roman numeral one
c, short for circa, means about

explanation.surface: A nature reserve with one bird is a lovely spot.
explanation.definitionFit: The superlative of pleasant or lovely.

clue.text: Uplifting creatures, directors, and that's right

indicators.note: in a down clue, lifting up the word means reading it from bottom to top

parts.note: rats are creatures
a company's directors form its board

explanation.surface: Cheering animals and company bosses, and that is correct.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Uplifting' looks like 'cheering' but reverses RATS to STAR.
explanation.definitionFit: On a ship, the right-hand side when facing forward has this name.

clue.text: Schemes to deceive-attempts to take a number in

parts.note: to con is to deceive

indicators.note: the attempts word takes in another letter, so 'take ... in' marks a container
together with 'take', it says the number is put inside

parts.note: tries are attempts
V is the Roman numeral five, a number

explanation.surface: Someone plots to cheat, trying to take in a figure.
explanation.walkthrough: The two words 'take' and 'in' together form the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: To devise or plot something cleverly is to engineer it.

clue.text: Sporting dog, fantastic trier at all times

indicators.note: fantastic suggests the letters are wildly altered into a new order

parts.note: ever means always, at all times

explanation.surface: A gun dog that is a tireless trier all the time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fantastic' rearranges TRIER into RETRI, then EVER.
explanation.definitionFit: A breed trained to fetch shot game is a gundog, a type of sporting dog.

clue.text: A New York union-it's no matter which

explanation.surface: A New York trade union says it does not mind which.
explanation.walkthrough: 'union' joins A and NY together.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means whichever one you like, it makes no difference.

clue.text: A quiet wood

parts.note: sh is the call for quiet

explanation.surface: A peaceful wood.
explanation.definitionFit: A common hardwood tree and its timber.

clue.text: The old-fashioned casual shirt is required still

parts.note: ye is an archaic form of 'the', as in Ye Olde Shoppe
a T-shirt is casual

explanation.surface: A dated T-shirt is still needed.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words mean up to now, even so.

clue.text: Handy tools for down-to-earth people

parts.note: reads as gadgets for practical folk, but means hand-held tools for people who dig in the soil, such as gardeners

explanation.definitionFit: Small hand tools with a flat blade, used by gardeners and bricklayers.

clue.text: Oriental writing a note back

parts.note: E is a musical note
astern means towards the back of a ship

explanation.surface: An Eastern scribe writing a reply note.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' looks like a reversal signal but is a synonym, ASTERN; 'writing' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Both mean from or relating to Asia, the East.

clue.text: Knock some of theninth item

indicators.note: only some of the letters of these words are used, a run spanning the gap

explanation.surface: Knocking off part of the ninth thing on a list.
explanation.walkthrough: The run sits across 'ninTH ITem'; the missing space in 'theninth' is a newspaper misprint.
explanation.definitionFit: To strike or bang something is to give it a blow.

clue.text: Vet a crawler without cash

indicators.note: without in the old sense of outside, so the crawler surrounds the money

parts.note: an insect is a creeping creature
p, for penny or pence, is a small amount of cash

explanation.surface: A vet checks a creep who has no money.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' looks like 'lacking' but means outside: INSECT goes round P.
explanation.definitionFit: To vet something is to examine it closely, scrutinise it.

clue.text: Report to do with spin

parts.note: re means concerning, to do with
a turn is a spin

explanation.surface: A report concerning a spin.
explanation.definitionFit: An official report, such as a tax form or election result, has this name.

clue.text: Cross servicemen in retreat could be impressive

indicators.note: retreating goes backwards, so the pieces are read in reverse order

parts.note: a cross, X, is the Roman numeral ten
GIs are American soldiers

explanation.surface: Angry soldiers falling back might make an impression.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cross' looks like 'angry' but is the X shape, ten in Roman numerals; TENGIS reads backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: A seal ring pressed into wax to leave a mark, so it literally makes an impression.

clue.text: Running water disturbing rest after midnight

indicators.note: disturbing the letters jumbles them into a new order

parts.note: am, ante meridiem, labels the hours after midnight

explanation.surface: Flowing water keeps someone awake in the small hours.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disturbing' rearranges REST into STRE, then AM.
explanation.definitionFit: A brook or small river is flowing water.

clue.text: Put down end on and shut up

parts.note: to inter is to bury, put in the ground

indicators.note: the end of the word on is its last letter

explanation.surface: Put down the end piece and be quiet.
explanation.definitionFit: To intern is to confine or imprison, especially in wartime.

clue.text: The individual who'll help satanists out

indicators.note: out suggests the letters are thrown out of order

explanation.surface: Someone willing to help devil-worshippers get out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' rearranges SATANISTS.
explanation.definitionFit: A helper or aide is someone who gives support.

clue.text: Judges love evergreens

parts.note: love is nil in tennis, the letter O
pines are evergreen trees

explanation.surface: Judges have a fondness for fir trees.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Judges' is a verb here: forms a view.
explanation.definitionFit: To judge, in the sense of giving an opinion, is to state a view.

clue.text: Finding base deed about right, twisted

parts.note: base means mean, low

indicators.note: the deed word goes about the letter, a container signal

parts.note: taken as the same word

explanation.surface: Discovering a low act concerning rights, all bent out of shape.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' gives DERED; 'Finding' is only a link, and 'twisted' describes a winding course.
explanation.definitionFit: A river that winds and wanders back and forth has done this.

clue.text: Hemp is used in the making of such a jacket

definitions.text: Hemp is used in the making of such a jacket

parts.words: Hemp is used in the making of such a jacket
parts.note: reads as a coat sewn from hemp fibre, but hints at a cannabis cigarette as well as a short double-breasted sailor's jacket

explanation.definitionFit: Both a marijuana cigarette and a close-fitting naval jacket go by this name.

clue.text: New Testament declaration

indicators.note: new suggests the letters are made into something fresh, a rearrangement

explanation.surface: A New Testament declaration.
explanation.walkthrough: 'New' looks like part of the Bible's name but rearranges TESTAMENT.
explanation.definitionFit: A formal declaration is an announcement or assertion.
